notes.title: Bamboo Sticks Update
notes.content: [h3]Dear Students,  [/h3][p][/p][p]Discipline in kung fu takes many forms. For centuries, masters have trained not only with their fists, but with the humble bamboo stick: a weapon of precision, reach, and flow. 🌿  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/43eec9475ab37adf81edf9a18818246ba94df2c3.png"][/img][/p][p]Today, I’m proud to bring that tradition into *Crazy Kung Fu*. With the **Bamboo Sticks Update**, you can now take on most levels wielding dual sticks instead of your hands and bracers. A new challenge, a new rhythm, and a new way to test your skill.  [/p][p]Whether you’re blocking lightning-fast strikes or landing your own combos, the bamboo sticks demand accuracy and speed. They offer power, but also responsibility: control is everything.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/e8db60613960c82cf6822fff2e20bc7aef279432.png"][/img][/p][h3]What’s new:  [/h3][list][*][p][b]Bamboo Sticks Gameplay[/b] — Play most levels with bamboo sticks instead of hands or bracers, they are in the MODS section.  [/p][/*][*][p][b]New Challenges[/b] — Striking and blocking with sticks introduces fresh timing and spacing.  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Immersive Feel[/b] — Train like martial artists have for generations, with precision tools instead of fists.  [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning, more training methods and features are coming. Thank you for your dedication and feedback; your practice inspires every update. 🙏  [/p][p]Stay strong, stay focused, and may your strikes be true.  [/p]

notes.title: 🏮Year of the Dragon Update!🏮
notes.content:
🏮 Dear Students,

As the vibrant Year of the Tiger 🐯 gracefully bows out, we stand on the threshold of the majestic Year of the Dragon 🐉. It's a time of immense energy, unwavering courage, and boundless possibilities. In this spirit I invite you to deepen your practice, embrace fitness, and cultivate health like never before. 🙏

In celebration of the new year, I am honored to introduce a symbol of protection and strength: the [b]Guardian [/b] mask. This free cosmetic piece is not just an adornment but a testament to your dedication and progress. Wear it with pride as you navigate through challenges, embodying the guardian spirit that watches over you and your path to mastery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/ecaaa7f9ac99039c991b9fc3156cbb1d2a311696.jpg[/img]

Complementing the [b]Guardian[/b], the [b]Crimson[/b] Bracers emerge as a beacon of passion and power. Crafted from the heart of the dragon's flame, these bracers are designed to inspire and propel you forward, adding a touch of elegance and fiercenes to your training. 👊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/91119e443012cc0f505e9a4c4c194dacafd701ce.png[/img]

As always, simply boot up the game and you'll be automatically gifted the mask and bracers!

This update also includes a few fixes, thanks to those who helped me track them down:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where in some instances in Train Tier 3 stats would displaying many more mistakes than you had actually made. Sorry about that! (Thanks to Zorro and The_Raven_Child).
[*] Fixed a similar issue where in some instances stats would display more total appeared punches/blocks than had actually appeared during the level. Making it impossible to get 100%! 😱
[*] Removed the ankward ending to levels when the dummy arms are no longer interactable on the last few seconds as it cools down.
[*] Revised some logic in the multiplayer session list so that when a session is available/unavailable the list updates much faster.
[*] Various other quality of life improvements, small things but still important. ❤️
[/list]

What's next: I'm working on private sessions so that you can sync up with friends more easily! 

I look forward to witnessing your achievements, celebrating your growth, and sharing this incredible journey with you. Here’s to a year filled with strength, health, and prosperity! 🙏

notes.title: Multiplayer is out now!
notes.content:
[h2]MULTIPLAYER (BETA)[/h2]
Currently one game mode only: COMPETE. Engage in thrilling 1-minute rounds against other players. Be the first to win 3 rounds to claim victory. But here's the twist: the losing player of the current round gets to send random mods (arrows, pads or speed) to the other player for an added challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/f63a79c64f753f1a05b827283467449f3c7c705e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] 📄[u]Tailor Your Sessions[/u]: Customize your multiplayer experience by creating your own session. Choose the number of arms and whether they should be double-sided. You can also filter and join existing sessions or select from the session list.
[*] 🔴[u]Get the Party Started[/u]: When you create a session, a ping will be sent to other in-game players and a dedicated Discord channel, letting everyone know there's a new session to join. So be patient!
[*] 🔥[u]Warm Up[/u]: While waiting for other players to join your session, you can warm up with some solo rounds. When a player joins, you'll be reset and ready to dive into the action.
[*] 💬[u]Communicate[/u]: Send/receive preset messages between rounds.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/40dccc432f90a0eea49c893b5bcb36e77da16cb3.png[/img]

[h2]UPDATES[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🎭[u]Mask cosmetics[/u]: Show off your unique look in multiplayer with the introduction of cosmetic MASKS, replacing the ITEMS category temporarily. Stay tuned for future seasonal content!
[*] 💡[u]Reflect on Your Choices[/u]: Explore your character's new look with the addition of a stylish mirror in the MY DOJO menu section. Admire your masks and bracers from every angle!
[*] 🎮[u]MR gaming[/u]: LIV compatibility is also added in multiplayer. Other players are represented by their bracers and masks, creating a more visually engaging experience.
[*] ⚡[u]Lightning-Fast[/u]: For those looking to amp up their workouts, the SPEED setting in the WORKOUT FLOW is now even faster, giving you a thrilling challenge!
[*] 💅[u]Shortcut to Success[/u]: Get to your MY DOJO in a flash with a handy shortcut button from game mode pages. You can easily set your bracers and masks and return to your previous game mode menu page without missing a beat.
[*] 🔋[u]Turbocharge Your Training[/u]: The speed mod in TRAIN now boosts overall speed instead of speed based on impact, providing a dynamic training environment.
[*] 💥[u]Feel the Kung Fu[/u]: bHaptics has been updated to v2, and redesigned from the ground up. Expect more haptic variety now depending on the dummy arms you hit and with which part of your body!
[/list]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🐛Fixed red orbs not making any sound when being hit in EXPERT in some instances.
[*] 🐛Fixed feedback being incorrect or inconsistent at the end of a TRAIN session in some instances.
[*] 🐛Fixed issue with stab pole in FIGHT TIER 2 breaking up when moving.
[*] 🐛Fixed issue with dummy not pivoting in TRAIN TIER 2 in some instances.
[*] 🐛Fixed issue with plank shards going through floor. (not really a bug, but it looks better now!).
[/list]

If you have any questions or feedback, let me know in the comments or on Discord!
As always, train hard and stay focused.

notes.title: Exiting Early Access with the Ultimate Update!
notes.content:
[h1][b] Introducing Crazy Kung Fu V1 🥋[/b][/h1]

Attention, all aspiring Kung Fu masters! Get ready for the [b]Ultimate[/b] update that will revolutionize your Crazy Kung Fu experience. Brace yourselves for a wave of thrilling features and enhancements that will take your training to new heights! Unleash your inner warrior like never before!

[b]New Menu System[/b] 🔥: 
Experience a revamped menu system that provides a sleek and intuitive interface, guiding you seamlessly through your Kung Fu journey. Easily navigate the game's content and access your favorite features with ease!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/497d1234c5fc3a064eea134399c5da29f8125de8.jpg[/img]

[b]New Game Mode: WORKOUT[/b] 💪🎮: 
Get ready to break a sweat in a fitness-focused game mode! Step into the ultimate workout experience that combines the art of Kung Fu with intense physical exercise. Engage in a series of dynamic movements and challenges specifically designed to elevate your heart rate, burn calories, and improve your overall fitness level. This game mode is not only a test of your Kung Fu skills but also a pathway to a healthier, stronger, and more energetic you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/943bbbf895bcf7baf5f58beccf9c0c863d2ce4e8.png[/img]

[b]New Game Mode: EVENT[/b] 🏋️‍♂️🌟: 
Experience weekly generated training routines tailored to your needs and abilities. Get personalized routines based on the exercises you've completed, ensuring a challenging and targeted fitness experience. Push your limits, achieve your goals, and become the Kung Fu master of your destiny!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/4e48871b32ed9621680a3e8b0aa8f61dc9cb289c.png[/img]

[b]Improved Gameplay[/b] 🎯: 
Fine-tuned gameplay mechanics ensure an even more immersive and satisfying experience. Execute lightning-fast strikes, showcase your lightning reflexes, and witness the fluidity of your movements as you train to perfection.

[b]Improved Scoreboard and Feedback Board Systems[/b] 🏆: 
Track your progress and celebrate your accomplishments with enhanced scoreboards and feedback boards. Gain valuable insights into your performance, analyze your strengths, and identify areas for improvement. Strive for greatness with every punch, dodge, and block!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/3ccbf6931689472fc603492387acab55bbdb67a2.jpg[/img]

[b]Improved Environments[/b] 🌍: 
Immerse yourself in breathtaking environments as you continue your training. Witness the stunning beauty of a tranquil bamboo forest, bask in the serenity of your very own dojo, and discover other awe-inspiring locales. Each environment comes alive with original soundtracks that elevate your Kung Fu experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/1948a36bb926fb1b451e08f85a306600370aba30.png[/img]

[b]DLCs: Dojos and Bracers[/b] 💪💥: 
Personalize your training grounds and style with stunning DLCs! Unlock unique dojos and stylish bracers to elevate your visual experience. Make a statement as a true Kung Fu force with these captivating additions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/e68bfc08064a34abaa54d83421fead38ec73b4ec.jpg[/img]

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b] ✨: 
Based on community feedback, numerous quality of life improvements have been implemented. Expect smoother gameplay, optimized mechanics, enhanced visuals, and an overall more polished and enjoyable Crazy Kung Fu experience.

[b]New Languages Added[/b] 🌍🗣️: 
Exciting news! French, German, Polish, Italian, Spanish, Japanese, and Korean language support have been added to Crazy Kung Fu. Immerse yourself in your preferred language, connect with a global community, and master the art of Kung Fu together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/10754429f22f1ed1fbbe208cb65e23a0bb3d859f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New rank: Expert
notes.content:
[b]Dear Students[/b] 

I've been working on this update for quite some time so I'm excited to finally push it out to you all. I've added a new ranking system for "Train" that splits up the Tiers and Levels as such:
[list]
[*] Novice: Tutorial
[*] Apprentice: Tiers 1 - 3 (The original Train Tiers).
[*] Expert: Tiers 1 - 3 (A new way to play the levels that requires a different skill 😉)
[/list]
There are a few things that change in Expert, the main one is that you must make contact with specific areas of the punch pads and blocks in order to get points, as well as a new dodge dummy arm where you also need to punch defensively. 👊💥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964535/4cee9d294ffb02c651e061548ba2d2cbf3e7f556.jpg[/img]
[i](the red spheres you need to make contact with to earn points in Expert)[/i]

[h3]Updates and fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Rank system: "Train" is now split into various Ranks, as you finish a Tier in one Rank, you can play it in the next.
The original 3 Tiers are now part of `Apprentice` rank, and currently you can play the next one: `Expert`. This rank includes a new way to play the levels that's more challenging but more rewarding. 
[*] Updated scoring system: Points are now relative to how close you were to making contact with the dummy arm (block/punch) at the right time. Making contact exactly when it meets the ghost will grant 100% points, the further you are off that, the less points you get. Level passing scores have been updated to match this. 
[*] New menu layout in Train section of the menu to allow for switching between ranks. As well as new colors for each rank.
[*] 22 achievements have been added to the store platform! There are now a total of 34 achievements.
[*] Fixed issue where after selecting music in the `Extra` section it was not possible to return to mods. 
[*] Blocking correctly now makes the dummy arm increase speed, rather than slow down. So watch out!
[*] Punching a blade from behind will not make the blade come back at you (yes that was a thing, but now it's not).
[*] Punch planks to start levels will not appear until a level has been selected for the Mode you are currently viewing. No more accidental tutorial triggering!
[*] Fixed issue where game wouldn't pause when removing your device from your head.
[*] Fixed issue where game hands would center in front of you when you press the device menu button.
[*] Stop Xmas tree from being switched out with the lantern every time you load the game (for those of you who want that Xmas feel all year round).
[*] Fixed issue with challenges on menu not displaying properly in some instances.
[*] Fixed issue where going from some menu pages back to Dojo editing the leaderboards would no longer appear. 
[/list]

If you have any questions or feedback, let me know in the comments or on Discord!

As always, train hard and stay focused.

notes.title: Update 0.84 - Fight Mode
notes.content:
[b]Dear Students[/b]

I've been very excited to work on this update, which revises the way Fight Mode works. There are a few core things that have changed which will make using this Mode much more enjoyable and practical in your Kung Fu journey. 

For example there is now a selection of 3 space sizes for Fight Mode, as to be able to cover a variety of play space and allow you to chose what fits best for you. The dummy in Fight Mode is also now much more aware of your space and will not drive you outside of the space you have selected. 

Already with these two new functionalities you should see an improvement in your training, allowing you to fully utilise your play area and further improve your skills without worrying about your physical environment.

There's more updates too, so check out the full list here.

[h3]Updates and fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fight Mode now has 3 play space size selections: 2x2, 3x3 and 4x4.

notes.title: Update 0.80 - Tutorial and accuracy!

[b]Dear Students[/b]

The theme of this update is "clearer instructions". That means that my main focus has been to help build a better understanding of how to play the game, the best way to get good scores and develop stronger knowledge of the overall game mechanics as a player.

[*] Ghost outline in Train Tiers 1 and 2 to show when to get the best accuracy.

[*] Readjusted all score thresholds to suit the new combo and accuracy system. (scores have been reset on leaderboards for Train Tier 1 and 2, time to get back to the top!).
[*] Fight Tier 3 complete achievement (Honour) now unlocks properly! Go get it!
[*] Reduced dummy arm speed of Train Tier 1 for less harsh onboarding of new players.
[*] Train Tier 2 dummy movement is now more fluid.
[*] Fixed text overlap in some areas.
[/list]

I hope this update is useful for all of you. If you have any questions or feedback, let me know in the comments or on Discord!

As always, train hard and stay focused.

notes.title: Update 0.50 - Fight Mode
notes.content:
Happy New Year! It's been a tough 2020 for everyone and I hope that I can help in some way to make 2021 better. Starting with a big update with a new game mode. 

I've really excited about this one, I've worked on it for a while. I've always wanted to make the dummy more active. In this new mode, Fight, you are against a similar dummy to Train mode but now it follows you, moves forwards, backwards, rotates full 360 and generally is more aggressive. 

In order to get scores you still need to strike the pads, block the poles and dodge the blades as in Train, but you'll also need to hit the pads that appear on the body of the dummy. These pads give you the highest points, and they can appear on any side of the dummy. So you will need to move around it, left and right, to get the pads when they appear. 

This mode is really to start bringing footwork to the experience. In Train we focus mainly on the upper body, now I want you to focus on your lower body too.

[h3]What's new:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Fight mode! In this mode you fight against a more active/reactive dummy. Currently this mode has 1 Tier (5 Levels). Once I've refined this mode enough I will add Tier 2, and then 3. Tier 1 Fight is only available once you have completed Tier 1 Train.
[*] Extended feedback after a Train mode level based on how you did. When completing a level, you will find a new board to your right with the detailed feedback.
[/list]

[h3]New look:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Menu scroll has now be redesigned to include Fight mode.
[*] Kung Fu mode is now called Train mode, to avoid confusion and make sense of the full journey. It now goes: Train, Fight, Focus, Study.
[*] Menu tabs have also been redesigned to be more practical when switching between sections.
[*] Study mode dummy and figurine are now to your right, and the menu scroll is back in the middle.
[*] Fight mode has it's own soundtrack! You can still disable music in the Extras setting, and play your own music externally while you train.
[/list]

[h3]Updates and fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Train global leaderboard now has the top 15 players (previously top 10).
[*] In Fight mode score points are displayed on impact. This will allow you to briefly see the scores you are getting with each strike/block. If this feature gets a good response I can add it to Train mode too.
[*] Fight mode also has new grades, one for amount of body pad hits and the other for amount of lateral movement. Moving around the dummy is essential to this new mode. 
[*] Correct punch plank is now displayed when returning to menu after Focus.
[/list]

[h3]What's next:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Further refinement of Fight mode. Then onto including Fight mode Tier 2.
[*] Fight mode Tier 2 to have new dummy arms (surprise!).
[*] Adding a global leaderboard to Fight mode (once scoring has been refined).
[*] New environment.
[*] New soundtracks.
[/list]

Thanks for the all support! Let's stay focused and train hard in 2021 together!

Arnaud

notes.title: WIP: Build your own level with Focus mode!
notes.content:
Fellow Students!

I've been hard at work lately with the new game mode. Initially I was making Tier 3 which includes new types of punches. Though I've put that on hold for now as I push this new mode forward. 

The mode called Focus will let you work on your selected skills only, either punching, block, dodging or your own mix!

You will also get to choose how many arms the dummy has (up to 3) and whether the dummy moves or not.

Focus Mode let's you create your own level with the following options: 
[list]
[*] Only punching, blocking, dodging, or your own mix
[*] How many arms are on the dummy (up to 3)
[*] If the dummy moves
[/list]

Over time I will refine this system and add more options, such as dummy and dummy arm speed, as well as other types of punches and movements as they are added to the main levels.

Creating your own levels and training programs will help you work on what you want to, to target any weakness and then go back into the full training mode to get those high scores.

Stay tuned for the release soon!

notes.title: Update 0.31 - Moving dummy and Tier system.
notes.content:

[*] New Tier 2! In this new tier you get to train against a moving dummy. The arm spins can be deceiving as the dummy rotates, so watch out as it tries to flank you left and right.

[/list]

[b]New look:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added floor graphic for Tier 2 for the moving dummy, though it will be replaced with a more interesting graphic soon as well.
[*] Updated scroll graphics and layout to fit the tier system.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where if players would pull the grip trigger over a button, the hand would no longer be able to select menu items.
[*] Combo scoring is now fixed, so scores will be higher throughout the game. Combos are x2, x3 and x4 scoring points. 
[*] Patched some snow clipping issues in the first dojo environment.
[*] Moved the Stop panel for the Infinite mode more behind the player on the right.
[*] 
[/list]
